general.description:
Wayne's World was an old discovered planet, but it was renamed in the honor of Mister Wayne, a brave explorer, for the service he has provided for the Alliance during the Cartelist war.
This is now a flourishing world, welcoming a mixed population of Humans and K'Rinns.
general.bar: K'Rinns and Humans chatting at the bar. You must try the Stellar Cocktail, too !
